title: Started spamming me
body: After not using my account for a year, app started spamming me several times a day to my email. Since I have ni access to the account I created and the smart developer did not include unsubscribe link in the email, I am giving one star. And marked the email as spam. Well done developers! Spoiler: next time include unsubscribe link that does not need for me to sign in.
author: warp23

title: Great potential, bad execution
body:
Disappointing. Looks good at the beginning (app name, icon, screenshots), even maybe sleek, but once you start digging deeper, you see that there is no quality control there, no care.
For example, the timer has upper limit 3h1m (?!), and if you try to scroll it more, it starts shaking, as it is an app from a 1-year mediocre student…

And the appearance is not satisfying, the colors and everything is a bit clunky..

title: App falling apart
body:
The app is getting worse quite consistently( I liked it a lot at the beginning!)

The basic functionality is deteriorating as developers focus on various beautifications - motivation quotes, challenges, icons and god know what. The response time is getting slower, synchronisation simply doesn’t work, UI in the web version became unusable after recent update. 

It is a shameful display of a good app being completely destroyed by a delusional product director. Fire them and use these money to hire a decent backend architect. 

Positives: works on the phone (most of the time), has data export.
author: v.2020.07

title: Aesthetic app
body:
Very aesthetic app. That’s the only reason I will not use any other app. I don’t like them. This one is beautiful. Would love to use it more if it gets smoother in workflow with notes(sync to Mac version) and overall better workflow with habits. For example tags instead of areas would be great

After the new design, overview if days of the week at bottom and overall better functionality I gotta raise to 5 stars! Love it! 
Would still appreciate tags, and especially ability to open the habit from the progress tab but the app does everything u need for habits and does it in a very smooth way 💪🏻 😍

title: Skvělá aplikace!
body: Aplikace nabízí jednoduché rozhraní iOS. V horní liště najdete přehledně dny, ve kterých se zazmenávájí vaše pokroky. Po rozkliknutí najdete veškerá data nejdelší řetězec, procenta úspěchu atd. Den je rozdělen na 4 fáze nebo můžete přepnout pro zobrazení všech návyků na jednou. Určitě oceňuju dostupnost aplikace na Apple Watch a iPad. Celkově jsem s aplikací velmi spokojen a proto dávám pět hvězd.
